description: A single, text-only table rendered as an image (Table 1, "Material parameters in the constitutive model") with four columns headed Symbols, Value, Equation number and Reference. It contains sixteen parameter rows, in reading order: μ0 (MPa) = 7.89 × 10^10 (Eq. (3), Zhang et al. (2016b)); Tm (K) = 1800 (Eq. (3), Xu et al. (2023)); KT0 = 680.912 (Eq. (3), Appendix A2); QKT = 23,134.8 (Eq. (3), Appendix A2); ψ = 9.92 × 10^-3 (Eq. (10), Appendix A2); q = 0.867 (Eq. (10), Appendix A2); Qdrx (J/mol) = 326,922 (Eq. (10), Appendix A2); Qp (J/mol) = 314,300 (Eq. (6), Appendix A2); A = 7.3214 × 10^11 (Eq. (11), Appendix A2); α = 0.0089 (Eq. (11), Appendix A2); n = 6.3742 (Eq. (11), Appendix A2); kd0 = 4.442 (Eq. (12), Appendix A2); Qkd = 728.468 (Eq. (12), Appendix A2); nAv0 = 18.097 (Eq. (12), Appendix A2); QAv = 21,895.1 (Eq. (12), Appendix A2); nc = 55.563 (Eq. (18), Appendix A2). There are no axes, scale bars, micrographs or error estimates; the table is purely a parameter list. Its scientific role is to fix the constitutive-model constants used by the 3D cellular automaton for low-alloy steel: thermal (Tm, KT0, QKT), softening/DRX (Qdrx, Qp, ψ, q), flow-stress (A, α, n) and nucleation/growth kinetics (kd0, Qkd, nAv0, QAv, nc).

observations.observation: Table 1 has four columns: Symbols, Value, Equation number and Reference, and lists exactly sixteen parameter rows.
The table gives μ0 = 7.89 × 10^10 MPa for Eq. (3), referenced to Zhang et al. (2016b).
The table gives Tm = 1800 K for Eq. (3), referenced to Xu et al. (2023).
The table gives KT0 = 680.912 and QKT = 23,134.8, both assigned to Eq. (3) and Appendix A2.
The table gives ψ = 9.92 × 10^-3, q = 0.867 and Qdrx = 326,922 J/mol, all assigned to Eq. (10) and Appendix A2.
The table gives Qp = 314,300 J/mol for Eq. (6), referenced to Appendix A2.
The table gives A = 7.3214 × 10^11, α = 0.0089 and n = 6.3742, all assigned to Eq. (11) and Appendix A2.
The table gives kd0 = 4.442, Qkd = 728.468, nAv0 = 18.097 and QAv = 21,895.1, all assigned to Eq. (12) and Appendix A2.
The table gives nc = 55.563 for Eq. (18), referenced to Appendix A2.
Units are printed only for μ0 (MPa), Tm (K), Qdrx (J/mol) and Qp (J/mol); the remaining symbols carry no unit in the table.
Fourteen of the sixteen parameters are attributed to Appendix A2, while μ0 is attributed to Zhang et al. (2016b) and Tm to Xu et al. (2023).
The caption states the table lists material parameters of the constitutive model.

The citing text states that the values of KT0, QKT, ψ, q, Qdrx, Qp, A, α, n, kd0, Qkd, nAv0, QAv and nc were obtained by genetic algorithm (GA) optimization, with the parameters determined when the global objective function was minimized, as shown in Table 1.
The citing text writes the DRX activation energy symbol as Qdrs whereas the table prints Qdrx — a symbol mismatch between text and table.
No statistical scatter, error bar or fitting residual is reported anywhere in the table; only single best-fit values are listed.
